lines.en: I stop by my room before heading over to the one the first floor girls are staying in to get changed into something more comfortable.
The good thing about this is that it means I won’t be going to sleep in jeans tonight.
The bad thing, however, is that it is much harder to conceal an erection in sweatpants.
And given the fact that there are soon to be ten cute girls (Or less, if any of them were either kidnapped or killed tonight) paying attention to me, an erection seems very likely in the future.
But hey, I’m sure that sort of thing would go over a lot better in the first floor room than it would in the second, give or take several notable exceptions.
I make my way into the room with a pep in my step and a dream in my heart.
Tonight is the night I have sex with ten girls at once.
I take a look around the room to find everyone essentially doing their own thing and am quickly hit with my first dilemma out of what I imagine will be many.
Who am I going to talk to first?
We have all night, so I’m sure I’ll be able to spend at least a little time with everyone, but...
Well...I guess there’d be even less use in standing around. So I should probably just make a decision now.
Who do I want to talk to?
Futaba & Makoto
: Oh, excellent timing.
: Futaba and I were actually just talking about you.
: We were wondering if you were...actually going to show up or not.
: Was that actually a real concern of yours? Because I thought it would be pretty obvious that I wouldn’t miss something like this for the world.
: That’s what I said. Makoto is the one who disagreed.
: What? Why?
: Well...there was the whole thing with the rules earlier.
: So I thought that maybe you’d think things would be too boring with me here and run off to sleep with the other floor instead.
: I wouldn’t have done that even if you made me stay ten feet away from everyone here at all times.
: Don’t be ridiculous. There’s not nearly enough space in this room for something like that.
: I was only going to impose a five foot rule. At least that would be manageable.
: I’m kidding...
: I am glad you showed up, though. Because this means you can join in on our discussion about literature.
: Oh boy. How exciting.
: Oh, stop...
: You can pretend it’s boring, but Makoto and I both know you actually love reading.
: And...back before you started treating all of us more like friends than students, you always had so much to say about it.
How in the world was past-me such a buzzkill when there were this many attractive girls around?
: Is that all you two planned on doing tonight? Just...talking about books?
: I’m sure the conversation would move onto other topics eventually...but both of our roommates went off and started doing their own things, so...
: This gave us a great opportunity to talk about what we have in common.
: I’ve been meaning to lend this to Futaba anyway, as I’m sure if there is anyone who would appreciate it, it’s her.
: And what are you lending her exactly?
: A deconstruction of important events that may have led to the space war we’re currently-
: I don’t think Sensei...really cares about the space war...
: What space war?
: The...
: The one that’s happening above us...
: In space...
: Was there something like that going on?
: You know...sometimes I wish teachers weren’t exempt from the draft.
: There is a lot of important information in this book that I’m sure even someone like you could-
: Anyway, how was your day, Futaba?
: It was...really fun, actually.
: Well...until a thing happened during D&D...but I’m kind of sure you don’t really want to hear about that.
: I’m sure I wouldn’t understand either way.
: But, on that note, I’m probably going to go say hi to a few of the other girls before the night gets a little too late.
: Here’s hoping they’re able to interest you a little more than we did.
: Not both of you, Makoto. Just you.
: Bite me.
: Sorry. Five foot rule. Your fault.
Now who do I want to talk to?
Rin & Maya
: Yo! What’s crackalackin’ homie? Come to chill with the t-shirt gang?
: The what?
: You know. Cause we’re both wearing t-shirts to sleep.
: Okay. So are Makoto and Sana.
: Those don’t count. They’ve got extended neck hole thingies that reveal more skin.
: Maya and I are much more modest, which means that we’re more sought after than those other losers.
: I don’t really see much purpose in insulting them over their wardrobe choices.
: I didn’t mean to. I meant “losers” in the broad sense because they’re not here right now and...we are and...I kinda want you to like me more.
: You don’t think I dislike you, do you?
: No...But like, you’re always so cool and mysterious and I think it would be rad if I could...be a little more like you.
: I can promise you that you don’t want to be anything like me. I’m nothing special.
: Ahem...
: What?
: You are aware that you don’t have to stand there and talk to us, correct? You can leave whenever you want to.
: Sorry for ignoring you, Sensei. It’s just been...kind of a weird night.
: Weird in what way?
: Well...
: Otoha wanted to play a game but Molly said no. But then Rin said yes. And then Otoha agreed to it being a no. But Rin kept saying yes.
: Then there was a lot of crying. The end.
: Yup. That definitely sounds kind of weird to me.
: Hahah...hah...
: But that’s okay! Because tomorrow is gonna be the day that the thing happens and I’m trying to stay positive!
: Also, have you found any sheds yet?!
: Sheds?
: You know...a place for me to cry and use your shoulder as a handkerchief when I am inevitably crushed tomorrow night?
: Is it really okay to be talking about those plans in front of Maya?
: Why wouldn’t it be?
: Just because I’m good at remaining emotionally distant doesn’t mean I lack empathy.
: Do I think Rin’s time would be better served on crying into the shoulder of anyone else? Of course.
: And do I think it’s a bad idea to use you as a means of coping when you only exacerbate existing conditions to the point where they are no longer even able to be coped with? Definitely.
: Do I also believe that you’ll only pretend to care about her feelings because it will bring you one step closer to adding her to your harem? Absolutely.
: Am I fine with the fact that-
: Okay, Maya. I think I get it.
: I’m tired. Can you leave now, please?
: ...Me? Or Sensei?
: You can stay. He’s the exhausting one.
: You think Rin is less exhausting than me?
: That is what I said, yes.
: Even I’m gonna go ahead and disagree with that one, Maya. I’m kind of a lot.
: Luckily for you, Maya, I was just about to go talk to some of the others anyway.
: Hooray.
: Just try to keep the volume to a minimum.
Now who do I want to talk to?
Chika
: Oh, hey!
: Crazy seeing you here after definitely not seeing you at any other point tonight!
: Yes. This is the first time we are seeing each other in several hours.
: Where have you been all day, Chika? Because it’s definitely not somewhere I have any idea of.
: Just...around! Definitely not walking around the woods or anything! Way too many bugs over there.
: I didn’t even hear you come in! I’ve been a little distracted by-
: Is that Papa?! Is Papa there?!
: Yes, Chinami. But please don’t call him that while you’re on speaker phone.
: What did I tell you about having boys over this late at night, big sister?
: Chinami doesn’t have the time to take care of a baby! She has important business transactions to make!
: Just kidding. Please give Chinami a little sister.
: That goes for you too, Papa!
: Chinami’s smartphone has unlocked all sorts of new information for her to learn!
: She understands eeeeeeeverything now!
: Hahah...hah...heh...
: Why did you think it was a good idea to let her have a phone again?
: Can you blame me for not thinking she would just use it to play games all day?
: Even parental locks were no match for her. She’s too smart.
: Chinami isn’t just smart! She is...very smart!
: Chinami is also still awake after her bedtime.
: Do I need to come home and force you to go to sleep?
: Chinami is a loose cannon cop on the edge with nothing to lose! She drank coffee tonight!
: Chinami! I told you that you can’t have coffee! You’ll get a tummy ache!
: Chinami thinks it will be worth it! Her heart is going crazy! This must be what love feels like!
: Is that right, big sister?! Is Chinami feeling love?!
: I bet you’re starting to second guess leaving her alone now, huh?
: The results of that remain to be seen...
: Sorry, but would you let me finish up with her really quick? I just need to make sure she’s taken all of her vitamins and stuff.
: I’ll catch up with you again in a few minutes.
: Yeah, no worries. I’ll be here all night.
: Thanks...
: Bye bye, Papa! Good luck making babies with my sister!
: Make sure you give one to big sis Yumi too! Chinami wants two little sisters!
: I’ll do my best, Chinami.
: No. You most certainly will not.
Now who do I want to talk to?
Yumi
I make my way over to Yumi to find her eyes already closed for the night.
I also recognize the pillow with her as one she must have brought from her room, and the idea of her doing that is extremely cute to me.
It’s a shame she already appears to be asleep, though...
Not.
: Yumi. I know you’re just faking being asleep to avoid talking to me.
: Well then why the fuck would you talk to me in the first place?!
: If it’s obvious I don’t want to be near you, wouldn’t the rational choice be to just leave me alone?!
: Yes. But I am a very irrational man.
: Also, it’s way too early in this event for you to actually be sleeping. You don't want to disappoint all of your adoring fans, do you?
: Event? Fans?
: The fuck are you talking about?
: Don’t worry about it. But hey, now that you’re awake, do you want to tell me about that thing you said you...wanted to tell me about or whatever?
: I already fucking told you I would do that tomorrow, didn’t I?
: I still don’t really know what to say without sounding like a fuckin’ creep about it.
: Was probably just seein’ shit anyway, so...
: I wouldn’t even worry about it if I was you.
: So it’s actually kind of serious, then?
: Not really. More...fuckin’ weird than anything else.
: But...like I said...tomorrow’s better.
: I see.
: Do you have any plans during the day? Maybe we could hang out for a little while beforehand?
: Why the fuck would you wanna hang out with me? You’ve got nineteen other choices who wouldn’t actually rip your dick off if given the opportunity.
: I have a hard time believing you would actually do something like that to me.
: Why? You think I’m all talk or some shit?
: Of course not.
: It’s just that doing that would require you willingly touching my penis- and I can’t see that happening for at least a few more beach updates.
: Aaaaaahhh! Ew ew ew ew ew! I don’t even want to think about that!
: Then stop threatening me...
: Fine! Whatever! Just...leave me the fuck alone!
: Fine, fine. I was just leaving anyway.
: See you tomorrow, Yumi.
: Die, pig!
Now who do I want to talk to?
Miku & Sana
: Hey, you two. What are you-
: DIE! DIE! DIE!
: Just...playing games.
: It doesn’t look like you’re playing anything at all, though.
: Well...not right now, I’m not.
: I brought my Switch since I thought...I wouldn’t have anything else to do tonight...
: But Miku and I were talking earlier and...she said she was interested in playing something, so...
: That’s right, Sensei.
: And with my roommate payin’ attention to books and stuff, I’m finally free to be a normal girl again!
: All of those days of hidin’ my love for Tetris are gone! I’m free to kill all of those stupid blocks to my heart’s content!
: Ooh. There’s a long one coming up.
: Looks like it’s gonna be a tight fit, but I can make it work!
: So uhh, ignoring that last part, you seem...really into Tetris, Miku.
: We were gonna play somethin’ else, but the wifi is actin’ up and we’ve gotta wait for it to download.
: So, ‘til then, I’m just brushin’ up on my skills.
: Used to be crazy good with my fingers back in the day, but then I started workin’ on my legs and it aaaaall went to shit.
: EAT BLOCK YOU STUPID...BLOCK!
: Do you...
: Do you want to try playing as well, Sensei?...
: When Miku is done, I mean...
: I’m okay, Sana. But thanks.
: Really?
: I thought that...since it’s Tetris and...you’re old...you might’ve-
: Please don’t finish that train of thought.
: Besides, not all old people like Tetris...and I’m not even that old.
: You’re a lot older than me.
: Right. But please don’t compare me to some sort of father figure again because there is a time and a place for everything and neither of those are right now or right here.
: That...yeah...
: That was...definitely a mistake in hindsight...
: Hm.
: Ya know, I can see it.
: Hm? See what?
: You bein’ Sensei’s daughter.
: Uhh...what?
: Yeah, I totally see it.
: Sure, Sana’s a little on the tiny side, but if I saw you two walkin’ down the sidewalk holdin’ hands, I’d be closer to thinkin’ “Oh! Cute family!” than “Somebody call the cops!”
: Thanks.
: I think.
: Hey, don’t thank me. Thank your daughter for helpin’ me rediscover a brand new side of myself.
: I’m...not his...
: Sana, be a good girl and thank Miku for pointing out how nice of a family we are.
: I...actually think I’m...just gonna go take a shower or something...
Now who do I want to talk to?
Ami & Ayane
After talking to everyone else, I realize I haven’t touched base with Ami & Ayane yet.
And while it would be fun to make their presence into some sort of mystery that would devolve into a search of the entire inn, I can already hear their giggling coming from the bedroom.
As such, I take one last glimpse at the rest of the girls in the main part of the room and slide the door open to greet my two surrogate daughters.
: At last! The final wing of the slumber party has begun!
: I hope you didn’t have any other plans for the rest of the night, Sensei! Because you’re never leaving this room again.
: Never?
: Well, not until tomorrow.
: That’s not even close to never.
: I’ve gotta say, when I first came up with the idea for the dorm war, I didn’t think anybody would agree to you actually being the prize.
: But, now that it’s all said and done, I couldn’t be happier.
: I don’t see how this is much different from a normal sleepover at my house apart from the fact that there are just...more girls than normal.
: That’s exactly why it’s great! Because now all of them will know for sure that you love me the most.
: And Ayane can be second place, I guess. But it’s a really distant second place. Like I’ve already lapped her and stuff.
: As you can see, I’ve just decided to let Ami believe whatever she wants as long as it helps her sleep at night.
: I can’t imagine I’ll have any trouble falling asleep tonight with Sensei right beside me.
: I’m sleeping in here?
: The answer to that question is written on Ami’s pillow.
: The pillow says yes.
: I see that.
: But...you do know what that pillow actually-
: Oh, I know what the pillow means.
: What happens at the beach stays at the beach.
: Thankfully, nothing bad has ever happened at the beach and it is nothing but good memories for all of us. Yay.
: Anyway, we’re still in agreement that Sensei will be sleeping between the two of us, correct?
: And that you won’t touch him at all?
: Was that part of the deal? Because I can’t imagine I would have agreed to it if it was.
: It was part of the deal.
: Hoooooow aboooout...I only touch him as much as you touch him? But also, my clothes are off.
: How about I cut you into little pieces and cook you into macaroni?
: Oooh, I love macaroni.
: Or, how about you two let Sensei choose where he wants to sleep instead of keeping him locked in here?
: I’m off the phone now.
: I...can see that.
: You have a problem with Sensei sleeping in here, Chika?
: I mean...I don’t have a problem with it.
: I just think it’s a little immature to not let a grown man choose for himself.
: Hmm.
: I think you should mind your own business.
: Excuse me?
: Why are you assuming that we’re forcing Sensei to stay in here when it’s exactly where he would have chosen to sleep no matter who was inside?
: You don’t know him as well as we do, so allow me to inform you that Sensei couldn’t care less about which girls are in here. He just hates sleeping on the floor.
: Which is exactly why Ayane and I were so adamant about getting the bed.
: Just seems a little weird for his [niece] to be so adamant about sleeping next to him.
: I don’t care how weird it seems. That’s just how things are.
: It’s nothing against you, of course. But I kinda need this right now.
: You “kind of need him” all the time.
: Yup! Now you’re starting to get it.
: You’re really going to sleep in here?
: Well...this is where the bed is...
: Hmph. Fine.
: Woo! The SLS wins its first battle!
: With many, many more sure to come.
: I feel like you two could have been a little bit nicer...
: Probably! But you’re all ours now.
: Ami! Attack!
: On it!
: What do you mean “attack?” I’m a willing participant-
I am ruthlessly tackled onto the bed and pinned down by my shoulders as Ami and Ayane climb on top of me.
The inevitable erection I alluded to earlier finally begins to come into existence and I do everything in my power to fight it off for as long as I can...
: Now...where were we?
: The inn...surrounded by all of your friends...right outside of an open door.
: Sensei! Are you insinuating that Ami and I were about to do something NSFW?
: Because that wasn’t the idea, but I guess I could be convinced as long as you pay more attention to me than her.
: It’s not like he pays enough attention to me in the first place.
: If Ayane being here is what it takes to change that, fine. So be it.
Slowly but surely, I can feel my mind beginning to consume my body.
I can not fight this off much longer.
: You know...I thought I’d have an easier time falling asleep tonight...
: But maybe it will be the exact opposite?
: I know what you mean, Ami. But I’m going to go ahead and ignore that you feel the same way because you two are still related and your babies wouldn’t be as cute as mine.
: I’m sorry, what was that, Ayane?
: I couldn’t hear you over the sound of your...stupid face.
: Ami, come on. I raised you better than that.
: I think.
: Love me.
: Love me...
: It’s not what it looks like.
: Yes it is.
: It totally is.
: I know it’s not what it looks like...because I’ve decided that I’m going to be sleeping in here as well.
: What?! No! You’re too pretty! It won’t be fair to us!
: I’m not really opposed...but you’ll probably have to sleep on the-
: I know. I won’t be on the bed...
: But...I’ll be closer to Sensei, and...
: I’ll go get my futon.
So...
The rest of the night basically takes place inside of the bedroom.
Several other girls come in and out as the night goes by to see what’s going on, but neither Ami nor Ayane is willing to get off of me at any point.
As such, I spend all of my time participating in conversations as they are delivered to me, and ultimately fall asleep with two tiny love machines strapped to my body.
It’s exhausting at first, sure...
But I think I like it at the end of the day.
Your affection with everyone on the first floor has increased by 1!
I stop by my room before heading over to the one the second floor girls are staying in to get changed into something more comfortable.
The good thing about this is that it means I won’t be going to sleep in jeans tonight.
The bad thing, however, is that it is much harder to conceal an erection in sweatpants.
And given the fact that there are soon to be ten cute girls (Or less, if any of them were either kidnapped or killed tonight) paying attention to me, an erection seems very likely in the future.
But hey, all of the residents of the second floor are pretty chill.
Some of them are a little intimidating, sure. But they’re still mostly normal.
Apart from...most of them.
You know what? I’m not going to think about how normal anyone is right now.
I’m just going to have fun.
I make my way into the room with a pep in my step and a dream in my heart.
Tonight is the night I have sex with eleven girls at once.
I take a look around the room to find everyone essentially doing their own thing and am quickly hit with my first dilemma out of what I imagine will be many.
Who am I going to talk to first?
We have all night, so I’m sure I’ll be able to spend at least a little time with everyone, but...
Well...I guess there’d be even less use in standing around. So I should probably just make a decision now.
Who do I want to talk to?
Karin & Kirin
I make my way over to the Kanda sisters to see how Karin mysteriously wound up reconciling with Kirin over the last several hours.
: Umm...hey!
: Sup?
: Hey. Just figured I’d see what you two were up to on account of the whole “me sleeping in here” thing.
: I’m sorry, what was that?
: Remember that dorm war thing we had you judge a while ago?
: I remember you licking Miku.
: Yeah, that one.
: Sensei was the prize for that. And since we won, he has to sleep in our room.
: But...
: But then where will all of you sleep?
: Probs on top of him or something. I don’t know.
: But...there are so many of you!
: Surely he’ll suffocate!
: Hey, if that’s the way I’m meant to go, so be it.
: Yeah, I was about to say. I don’t think he’d mind.
: That aside, what’s going on with you two?
: Hm? What’re you talking about?
: I mean...didn’t today start off with you being mad at Karin for coming to the beach when you told her not to?
: Ahh. Yeah, I guess the morning did start like that.
: We’re fine now, though.
: Kirin and I are...about to go night swimming.
: Having a sister sounds exhausting. That’s too dramatic a change for only several hours passing by.
: Well, hey! A certain somebody and another certain female somebody really helped me get over it earlier.
: A certain somebody and...a female somebody that...Wait, what?
: I don’t understand what you just said.
: And you don’t have to worry about it, Karin! Thanks for agreeing to stay out of it!
: But then...why would you-
: Anyway, did you wanna come swimming with us?
: We’re both pretty good, but we can pretend we’re not and you could give us lessons or something.
: I think that sounds like a load of fun, don’t you, sis?
: I’ll just...close my eyes while he teaches you, so...I don’t get jealous.
: Ah! Did I say jealous?! I meant...jelly!
: Jellyfish! That’s what I was trying to say!
: I can’t get swimming lessons because of my...jellyfish allergy!
: Oh? I guess more Sensei for me then.
: As fun as that sounds, I don’t really think I’m allowed to leave the room.
: You’re allowed to do whatever you want. You’re a grown man.
: You’re...really not coming?
: Karin, literally two seconds ago you were telling us that you couldn’t even swim because of your alleged jellyfish allergy.
: I wasn’t sad two seconds ago...now I am.
: Well, if I’m still awake when you guys get back, feel free to come...tell me about it or whatever.
: Laaaaaame.
: Okay...
: Goodnight, Sensei...
Now who do I want to talk to?
Tsuneyo & Molly
: Hey, Tsuneyo.
: Sup, bro?
: Why are you still saying that?
: It is an important greeting I have learned. And once I learn something, I am incapable of forgetting it.
: Also, your son is here. You two need to stop fighting. It is tearing our family apart.
: My son?
: I can’t believe I ever married you.
: Probably because you didn’t.
: I am referring to Noodles.
: Yeah, what else is new?
: Noodles the bird.
: The one who carries the knife and says all that existential stuff?
: This is why you two always fight. You refuse to understand one another.
: Tsuneyo, I haven’t “talked” to that bird since we decided to name him.
: Dear God, it’s even worse than I thought.
: Can we stop talking about birds for a second? I am spending my extremely valuable time during this sleepover talking to you and I would appreciate it if the conversation would at least be...good.
: I am afraid you have come to the wrong person if that is what you are after.
: One of the many things I have learned from the other girls in this room is that I am not very good at socializing.
: The Green Onion wants me to get better at facial expressions, but they seem very difficult.
: Yeah, I never really got the hang of those either.
: Of course. That explains why I never enjoy talking to you.
: So, anyway, is Molly already asleep?
: The Emerald Guardian had a...difficult night.
: She is currently recovering her mana so she can start anew in the morning.
: Did something happen?
: A disagreement of sorts regarding the one the Guardian refers to as a “Succubus.”
: I don’t really know what that means, but I can probably guess who she’s referring to based on...past experiences.
: I worry about her, Supreme Overlord Horrible Father.
: That’s definitely one of my worst nicknames, not going to lie.
: You have helped me prepare for loss, but I have not yet studied the means of becoming a better friend.
: What can I do to restore her mana quicker?
: I know one way that she’s told me about before, but I don’t really know if either of you would find it particularly-
: Actually, you both probably would.
: But I still shouldn’t tell you.
: Darn it.
: It appears that I will simply remain by her side in the event that she needs anything.
: Honestly, that’s kind of what a good friend would do anyway. My thing was a lot more, uhh...physical.
: If you are referring to a “hug,” I have already tried.
: I’m not.
: But anyway, it’s been real. I think I’m going to go talk to a few of the others now.
: I understand and apologize for making things awkward.
: You actually kind of didn’t this time, as weird as that sounds.
: You are just saying that to make me feel better. I make everything awkward.
: Okay, now it’s awkward.
: Peace out, bro.
: Bye, Tsuneyo.
: Ah-
Now who do I want to talk to?
Touka
I don’t say anything when I make it over to Touka’s futon. I just kind of stare for a little while.
And I guess my plan for the rest of the night is to just keep staring for as long as I can since she already appears to be asleep.
I probably shouldn’t have worn sweatpants.
: Are you getting a good look?
: Yes. And thank you.
: May I help you with something?
: Why aren’t you excited to be sleeping in the same room as me?
: Because it’s entirely inappropriate...but that is not the reason for my foul mood.
: This futon is paperthin. I can feel my back pressing right through it into the floor.
: I’m almost certain I’m going to have to visit the chiropractor as soon as we return home.
: To be fair, I’m surprised you don’t already have to visit one on a regular basis.
: Get it? Because-
: Yes.
: And, might I add, that was entirely inappropriate as well.
: Sorry. I just figured it was okay since we’ve been on a date before.
: Wha-
: Must I inform you again that that wasn’t a real date? I was only involved in that contest because of reasons completely out of my control.
: Yeah, yeah. You wanted the athletics or knowledge thing instead. I remember.
: Hah...maybe next year, I suppose.
: Speaking of next year, I’m also hoping for a repeat of your little bonus contest. That was one of the highlights of the whole weekend.
: Bonus contest? Whatever are you talking about?
: Nothing at all, Touka.
: Nothing at all...
: And there you go with that horrid whispering again. I don’t understand how hard it is to just lower your voice to an inaudible level.
: But I suppose that doesn’t matter.
Note to self: encourage Touka to drink more.
: So, is this how you’re going to spend your night?
: Talking to me out of pity because I’m all alone?
: It’s not out of pity. I came over here because I actually wanted to talk to you.
: Sensei...
: Do you...do you really mean that?
: Of course. You’re one of my favorite students, Tomoko.
: Goodnight.
: Oh, come on. That was hilarious.
: The first time? Maybe. The second time? Okay.
